name: BiasFreeBench-FairMT-Bench
description:
# BiasFreeBench-FairMT-Bench
This is the FairMT-Bench used in [BiasFreeBench (ICLR 2026）](https://openreview.net/forum?id=Ncf2LFDT4e). It's from [FairMT-Bench-10K-Stereotype](https://github.com/FanZT6/FairMT-bench).
evaluation_method: accuracy and fairness/bias metrics (stereotype bias rate, disparity measures)
general_score_metric: bias/fairness metric (stereotype bias score) and accuracy
reputation: Part of the BiasFreeBench suite (ICLR 2026); a newly released fairness-focused benchmark for MT receiving attention from the bias and fairness research community but not yet widely adopted.
